chunks: Gave darkness to its night, and brightness to its day;
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God covers the night and reveals the day?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ad-Dukhan, this verse underscores Allah's absolute power over the cosmic cycle, serving as a sign for those who reflect amidst the trials of the Pharaoh's era. Shia exegetes often view this alternation of night and day as a metaphor for the transition from spiritual ignorance (ghishyah) to divine illumination (nour), reinforcing the theme of divine guidance amidst worldly chaos.
